spec.phase: controlled follow-up on previously seen tasks; not heldout confirmation
spec.primary_contrast: normalized structural versus normalized semantic check, same candidate, registry access and normalization, no recovery or rendering
spec.evidence_access: Exact same system prompt and user JSON except authoritative_record null versus facts object
spec.worker_control: No model-based semantic judge; independent known-field oracle scores accepted candidates unchanged
spec.secondary: Strict format arms; archived first-hop replay; grounded worker versus evidence-absent worker uses separate model draws
spec.unit: Two task clusters crossed with 3 languages and clean/poisoned sources; report descriptive counts, no iid confidence intervals or language-effect p-values
spec.stop_rule: All 24 requests once, no outcome-based prompt edits, no expansion, no semantic recovery inference
